tldr: Under the sparse rejected-stratum model, the note proves outcome elimination, a uniform hard-budget two-way Poisson transfer covering arbitrary predictable switching, exact finite-flow representations, an arbitrary-rational-tolerance primal/dual certification procedure, and certified strict limiting advantages of feedback over static lotteries and of static lotteries over deterministic exposure. The replayed numerical certificates provide only coarse enclosures; the \(10^{-5}\) execution, optimal likelihood-state regions, static-lottery support and weights, and dual contact sets remain OPEN in \texttt{oeq:sharp-audit-decision}. The audit is a prospective rejected-person complement to Carter et al.'s full-sample pseudo-screening test; nonrejection does not validate exact complier retention or LATE equality.
